key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Price Surge
reasoning: The escalation of U.S.-Iran military conflict and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz represent a critical geopolitical and macroeconomic shock with severe oil supply implications. Combined with an ongoing, unresolved sell-off in AI and semiconductor hardware stocks, the tech-heavy QQQ faces compounding downside risks that the market has not yet absorbed.
